builder.language: python3 standard library only; no network, no subprocess
builder.reason: The case needs a legal ZIP with a traversal-shaped entry name and two different 16 MiB deterministic payloads; the builder writes them directly and re-reads each record completely.

capabilityReport.note: A platform lacking any of these fails D070 preparation for that platform; the invocations are not merged or degraded.

targetMatrix.target: symlink whose referent holds a sentinel
the original input path of entries.zip

observationContract.observer: public cancellation callback that always returns false and reads only the final path, plus a concurrent reader with a deadline
observationContract.forbidden: a private phase hook, a call-count assertion or a phase matcher
observationContract.readRule: each read opens one handle and checks the complete content through that handle, so content before and after a rename is never concatenated
observationContract.finalRequirement: the complete new file is observed at least once and no temp file remains; an absent file must not pass vacuously

certificationObligations: The Windows/symlink/hardlink/atomic-rename capabilities are measured during preparation; a platform lacking a capability fails preparation, and the eight invocations are not merged into one any-error.
An observation reads the complete bytes through a single opened handle, and each pattern byte is determined independently as (i*multiplier+add)%256, matching the recorded payload SHA-256.
originalFilesUnchanged checks the original input path, the original handle and a sentinel at the same time; force must not bypass the symlink or input-alias check.
../escape appears only as an entry name: the explicit safe output must receive the payload and no path outside the output directory may exist.
Two publishers use different payloads; exactly one may succeed, the other must observe TargetExists, and the final file must equal the actually successful payload byte for byte.
gaps: The extract seam, its publication primitive and its error kinds are application behavior; this worktree has no file publisher and no Engine, so no observation was manufactured.
The atomicity claim rests on the measured platform primitives and the ALGORITHMS 14.3 review; a finite reader sampling does not prove all OS scheduling.
Only this platform (Darwin arm64) was measured; Windows capability remains unmeasured.
pathBase: case-root: every repository source path is relative to tests/e2e/sources/<case>/, and every generated artifact path is relative to the repository root under .cache/e2e/.
measurementPolicy: Asset sizes and hashes are produced by preparation from actual bytes under the ignored execution workspace; no author cache or hand-maintained measurement file is a prerequisite.
